title: Glowing football
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffaa" stop-opacity="0.35"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0.12"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffdd44" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="44" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- ball body - bright white/cream -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="30" fill="#f2ede0"/>

  <!-- shadow side for depth -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="58" rx="22" ry="22" fill="#d8d0bc" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- pentagon center: warm gold -->
  <polygon points="50,32 59,39 56,50 44,50 41,39" fill="#e8b830"/>

  <!-- pentagon edge highlight -->
  <polygon points="50,32 59,39 56,50 44,50 41,39" fill="none" stroke="#f8d560" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- surrounding dark patches - slate/purple lit -->
  <polygon points="63,26 72,34 69,45 59,39" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <polygon points="78,48 74,59 63,56 66,44" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <polygon points="68,70 58,73 54,63 65,58" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <polygon points="42,73 32,69 36,59 47,62" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <polygon points="23,50 28,39 39,43 35,54" fill="#5a4a7a"/>
  <polygon points="32,28 41,24 44,35 35,39" fill="#5a4a7a"/>

  <!-- patch edge highlights -->
  <polygon points="63,26 72,34 69,45 59,39" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="78,48 74,59 63,56 66,44" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="68,70 58,73 54,63 65,58" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="42,73 32,69 36,59 47,62" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="23,50 28,39 39,43 35,54" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="32,28 41,24 44,35 35,39" fill="none" stroke="#8a7aaa" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- stitching lines (subtle) -->
  <line x1="50" y1="32" x2="44" y2="50" stroke="#c8b890" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="32" x2="56" y2="50" stroke="#c8b890" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="59" y1="39" x2="69" y2="45" stroke="#c8b890" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>
  <line x1="41" y1="39" x2="32" y2="28" stroke="#c8b890" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- specular shine -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="36" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.55" transform="rotate(-30 40 36)"/>

  <!-- tiny light dots around for glow effect -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="1.5" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="82" r="1.5" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="27" r="1" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="27" r="1" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="73" r="1" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="73" r="1" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
